info.name: Create a comment or attachment-only entry

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

params.name: id
params.description: a string to be decoded into a number

items.docs: Creates a text-only comment, attachment-only entry, or mixed comment+attachments on a receipt. Allowed only while the receipt is in Draft or Submitted status. All writes are transactional. Mentions are extracted from body_html.

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

params.name: id
params.description: a string to be decoded into a number

params.name: commentId
params.description: a string to be decoded into a number

items.docs: Updates a comment body (re-sanitized), adds new attachments, or removes existing ones. Mention diff is computed within the same transaction. Author-only — only the original comment author may edit. Allowed only while the receipt is in Draft or Submitted status.

params.name: entityId
params.description: The UUID of the Platform entity

params.name: id
params.description: a string to be decoded into a number

params.name: commentId
params.description: a string to be decoded into a number

items.docs: Soft-deletes the comment, cascades to its linked attachments, and hides the associated activity log entry. Author-only. Allowed only while the receipt is in Draft or Submitted status.
